fields.label: Apportionment method
fields.value: Kansas applies a standard equally weighted three-factor formula consisting of property, payroll, and sales factors divided by 3. A qualifying taxpayer whose payroll factor exceeds 200% of the average of the property and sales factors may elect a two-factor formula.
fields.quote: (A) For purposes of this subsection (b)(2), a qualifying taxpayer is any taxpayer whose payroll factor for a taxable year exceeds 200% of the average of the property factor and the sales factor.

fields.label: Sales sourcing (services and intangibles)
fields.value: Receipts other than sales of tangible personal property are sourced using cost of performance. Sourcing is assigned to Kansas if the income-producing activity is performed in Kansas, or if a greater proportion is performed in Kansas than in any other state based on costs of performance.
fields.quote: or (2) the income-producing activity is performed both in and outside this state and a greater proportion of the income-producing activity is performed in this state than in any other state, based on costs of performance;

fields.label: Special industry rules
fields.value: Railroads and interstate motor carriers apportion income using mileage-based formulas. Additionally, investment funds service corporations apportion based on shareholder domicile, qualifying telecommunications companies may elect a two-factor formula, and manufacturers of alcoholic liquor selling to distributors must use the three-factor formula.

fields.label: Sales/use tax: economic nexus
fields.value: A remote seller establishes economic nexus if cumulative gross receipts from sales to customers in Kansas exceed $100,000 in the current or preceding calendar year, with no transaction count threshold. Tax collection obligations begin with the next transaction immediately after exceeding the $100,000 threshold.
fields.quote: or (b) during the current or immediately preceding calendar year, the retailer had in excess of $100,000 of cumulative gross receipts from sales by the retailer to customers in this state.
